pages.title: Isomer Trigger
pages.text: A gamma pulse knocks a hafnium-178m2 nucleus out of its long-lived state, and all its stored energy comes out at once.$(br2)Generates power.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 4$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Burns Hafnium-178m2 for a great deal of power. Needs a Cobalt-57 source in an input slot for the gamma pulse that triggers it (never used up).
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (2 item and 0 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Hafnium Dust.
